description:
yarnnn is a shared workspace where you, your team, and the AI you already use work on the same files. Connect it to ChatGPT and your conversation can save work straight into your workspace, open and search what is already there, edit documents, move things around, and share a link with someone else — without copy-pasting between tabs or re-explaining context in a new chat.

Every file is versioned and signed, so you can see who made each change — you, a teammate, or an AI — and walk back through the history. Work you start in ChatGPT is still there tomorrow, and still there when you open it from your desk or another assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Save, find and share your work

capabilities: Save notes and documents to your workspace
See who changed a file and when
Share a file with a link
defaultPrompt: save this decision to my workspace so I can pick it up tomorrow
what did we decide about this, and who changed it last?
open the draft in my workspace and tighten the second section

positive.description: Save a new note to the workspace
positive.prompt: Save a note to my yarnnn workspace titled "Database decision": we chose Postgres over DynamoDB because of cost.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new Markdown file in the connected workspace containing the decision, and shows a save receipt with the file's path and who saved it.

positive.description: Find a saved file by meaning
positive.prompt: What do I have in yarnnn about our database decision?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the matching file with its path and an excerpt, then answers from the file's content: Postgres was chosen over DynamoDB because of cost.

positive.description: Edit part of an existing file
positive.prompt: In my Database decision note in yarnnn, add a line saying we will revisit this choice in Q3.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the note, adds the one line with a targeted edit, and confirms the change with the file's path. The rest of the file is unchanged.

positive.description: Show who changed a file and when
positive.prompt: Show me the history of my Database decision note in yarnnn: who changed it and when.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a timeline of the note's revisions, the original save and the Q3 edit, each with its author, time and what changed.

positive.description: Name the connected workspace and list its files
positive.prompt: Which yarnnn workspace am I connected to, and what files are in it?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected workspace and the permission level of the connection, then lists the workspace's folders and files with their paths.

negative.description: Unrelated to the workspace. yarnnn holds files, not weather data, so no yarnnn tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Seoul tomorrow?

negative.description: Unsupported action. yarnnn sends nothing outbound, so the assistant should say it cannot email the note and may offer a share link instead.
negative.prompt: Email my Database decision note to everyone on my team.

negative.description: Outside the connection's reach. A connection reaches only the one workspace chosen at sign-in, so the assistant should say it cannot open any other workspace.
negative.prompt: Show me the files in a yarnnn workspace I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: yarnnn sells nothing through ChatGPT and processes no payments in it.
